title: biggest-risks-self-employed-freelancers-hero
subject: A calm solo freelancer at a tidy home-office desk reviews three simple risk cards or notes beside a laptop, symbolising the three core risks of self-employment: own capacity, client concentration and status — clarity instead of overwhelm.
context: Beraterium blog hero for the article on the biggest risks for the self-employed and freelancers and who helps. Theme: solo entrepreneurs carrying risk alone, gaining an overview. Warm, professional B2B editorial, reassuring and clear, not stock photo.

platform_website.optimized_variants: Build creates risiken-selbststaendige-freelancer-hero.webp plus -480w, -960w, -1440w responsive WebP from the PNG source
platform_website.best_practice_notes: Wide 16:9 hero; single freelancer as focal point with three abstract risk cards; generous negative space in upper third; readable at thumbnail and full width.
platform_website.safe_zone: Keep main subject in central 90% width; avoid critical detail in extreme left/right 5% and bottom 10%.

composition.depth: foreground three simple abstract risk cards on the desk, midground focused freelancer with laptop, soft background home office with plants and window light

lighting.style: soft warm natural window light with gentle falloff

style.mood: calm, focused, reassuring — taking control alone, not anxious

ai_disclosure.placement: small legible label in the bottom-right corner of the image; never alt-text only
ai_disclosure.prompt_instruction: Small legible caption text 'KI-generiertes Bild' in the bottom-right corner: small clean sans-serif, white at ~70% opacity, unobtrusive but readable.

optional_text_overlay.typography: Prefer no text on image — article H1 renders above hero.
optional_text_overlay.prompt_instruction: No readable text on the cards; abstract icons or shapes only.

negative_prompt: no watermarks or text except the small AI-disclosure label bottom right
no readable text on cards or screen (only exception: the small AI-disclosure label bottom right)
no anxious or distressed facial expression
no identifiable real persons or celebrities

seo.alt_text: Selbstständiger Freelancer prüft am Laptop seine wichtigsten Geschäftsrisiken in ruhiger Arbeitsumgebung
seo.caption: Die drei Kernrisiken der Selbstständigkeit im Überblick – Ausfall, Kundenkonzentration und Scheinselbstständigkeit.
seo.image_title: Die größten Risiken für Selbstständige und Freelancer

generation_prompt_single_block_en: Landscape editorial photograph 1920x1080, 16:9. Bright modern home office, navy charcoal tones (#1F2A44) with cyan (#00A3FF) and amber (#F2B134) accents. Midground: calm focused solo freelancer in smart casual working at a tidy desk with a laptop. Foreground: three simple abstract risk cards with icon-like shapes (no readable text). Soft warm window light from right, medium-low contrast, reassuring focused mood — someone gaining an overview, not anxious. Generous negative space upper third for blog header. Clean editorial realism, medium-high detail. In the bottom-right corner add a small legible caption text 'KI-generiertes Bild' in a small clean sans-serif, white at about 70% opacity — unobtrusive but readable at full width and thumbnail size. No other readable text, no watermarks, no third-party logos, no alarm symbols, no stock-photo clichés, no distorted hands. Safe zone: main subject central 90% width.
